'''Chika Fujimura''' (Japanese: '''藤村知可''' ''Fujimura Chika'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Fujimura was born on March 28, 1981 in {{wp|Gifu Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Fujimura started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|RS}} in [[AG184]], only being credited as '''ちか''' ''Chika''. She wouldn't voice another character until [[DP134]] in {{aniseries|DP}}. In {{aniseries|BW}}, she picked up more roles such as the [[Nurse Joy]]s of the [[Unova]] [[region]] and the [[Decolore Islands]], as well as [[Cilan's Pansage]]. In {{aniseries|SM}}, Fujimura's major roles are [[Mallow's Tsareena]] and [[Wicke]].
